title: Corporate Outlook Password Reset Procedure
solution:
1. Navigate to identity.company.com.
2. Click 'Self-Service Password Reset'.
3. Complete MFA challenge via Authenticator App.
4. Enter new compliant password (16+ chars).
5. Wait 5 minutes for AD synchronization.

title: SSO Token Expiration and Session Cache Clearance
solution:
1. Clear browser cookies and local storage for domain *.company.com.
2. Revoke active OAuth tokens via Okta dashboard.
3. Execute 'kinit -R' on Linux workstations to refresh Kerberos tickets.

title: EC2 High CPU Remediation Playbook
solution:
1. Run top/htop to identify rogue PID.
2. Inspect CloudWatch metric granularities (1-min intervals).
3. Scale ASG desired capacity by +1 if traffic surge.
4. Capture thread dump if Java process, then issue SIGTERM.

title: Java Spring Boot NullPointerException Troubleshooting
solution:
1. Inspect stack trace line number.
2. Verify @Autowired dependencies are registered beans.
3. Check Optional wrapper implementations on service layer queries.
4. Enable debug log level: logging.level.org.springframework=DEBUG.

title: AWS Cost Anomaly Investigation
solution:
1. Access AWS Cost Explorer -> Anomaly Detection.
2. Filter by UsageType to locate resource spikes (e.g., Unblended Cost).
3. Check orphan EBS volumes, NAT Gateway egress, or unattached Elastic IPs.
